verdict.rationale: A government tax-services portal could plausibly publish machine-readable API specs (for example for e-invoicing or data services), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an API, an OpenAPI file or any downloadable machine-readable spec. The 'Statistiques et Données' link is a related data section, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
